content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran converter that allocates station time-series and interpolated boundary arrays (lines 1-28), configures enabled boundary sides and spatial scaling/trimming (lines 30-66), reads sequential sta_NNNN files for east/west/south/north stations (lines 68-179), interpolates each side spatially for every recorded time (lines 181-245), selects a starting time (lines 249-255), and writes a labeled coupling.txt boundary/time-series file (lines 257-323).
entities: west_z, west_u, west_v and time real arrays @L3
implicitly typed integer counters and configuration nsta, nwest, nsouth, neast, nnorth, iscale, J_START_*, J_TRIM_*, Nsm_*, k, ktime, Ndata, I, II, III, Kstart and digit temporaries @L34
implicitly typed real time_cut and tmp @L41

params_defined.name: time_cut
params_defined.range: must not exceed last available time for safe search

params_defined.name: iscale
params_defined.range: positive; derived Nsm_* must not exceed Nb

north interpolation weight computed from implicitly integer operands

unresolved: Definite interpolation defect: I, II, III, and iscale are implicitly INTEGER, so tmp=(III-II)/iscale on the west/east/south/north interpolation paths (west block around line 189 and lines 204, 219, 234) performs integer division before assignment to real tmp. With iscale=2, the interior weight is 0 instead of 0.5, collapsing intended linear interpolation to repeated endpoints.

Cross-file length/time mismatch: every station read overwrites the shared time vector and scalar Ndata (for example east lines 84-90 and west lines 112-118). The later global loop DO K=1,Ndata at line 183 therefore uses only the last-read station's length and time base for every side and station; if files differ, earlier shorter arrays are read uninitialized or earlier longer samples are silently truncated, and differing timestamps are never compared.

Inactive-side header defect: nsouth, neast, and nnorth are zero on lines 36-38, but the formulas on lines 58-60 yield Nsm=-1. Lines 261, 265, and 267 still write boundary counts derived from those values, producing -1 points for inactive east/south/north sides instead of a nonnegative zero count.

Out-of-bounds search: lines 251-254 increment Kstart while TIME(Kstart)<time_cut without checking Kstart<=Ndata (or Ntotal). If time_cut exceeds the final available timestamp, TIME is indexed beyond valid data and potentially beyond its allocation before the loop can terminate.

No configuration checks enforce 0<=nside<=nsta_tot, iscale>0, Nsm_side<=Nb, or valid start/trim bounds before interpolation and implied-DO output indexing; changed inputs can divide by zero or exceed coupling-array bounds.

Station OPEN/READ operations have no IOSTAT/ERR handling other than END= labels. Missing files or malformed records are unchecked fatal errors, and a file containing exactly Ntotal records leaves no capacity to detect additional data.

The configured nsta value on line 34 is not used to validate that nwest+nsouth+neast+nnorth equals the intended number of sequential sta_NNNN files, so filename-to-side mapping can silently drift when side counts are edited.
